regression-full.title: Overfitting onset
regression-full.message: Best eval/loss was 1.271 at step 7; it's since risen to 2.198 (72.9%, slope p<0.0001). Meanwhile train/loss kept falling over the same range (slope < 0) -- the classic overfitting signature.
fixes: Use the checkpoint at step 7 (best eval/loss), not the last one.
Add or increase regularization: weight decay, dropout, data augmentation.
Reduce model capacity or train for fewer steps / add early stopping.
Get more training data, or de-duplicate against the eval set if overlap is possible.

smooth-six.title: Eval metric too noisy to rank checkpoints
smooth-six.message: Typical step-to-step jitter in eval/loss (0.1003) is 16% of the whole run's total improvement (0.646) -- adjacent checkpoints may not be meaningfully different.
fixes: Evaluate on more data, or average multiple eval passes/seeds before comparing checkpoints.
Select checkpoints by a smoothed (e.g. EMA) version of this metric instead of the raw value.
Evaluate less frequently but on a larger sample each time, if eval cost is the constraint.
